evals.name: spread-across-zones
evals.prompt: Spread the web deployment in web-prod across zones.
evals.expected_output: Runs `cub manage preflight`, checks `cub manage scheduling spread --cluster <c>` for the workload's current source and the cluster default, previews `cub manage scheduling set-topology-spread web-prod/web` (zone, maxSkew 1, ScheduleAnyway) dry-run, then commits with --commit --change-desc. No cluster apply; no gate bypass.

evals.name: anti-affinity-prefers-soft
evals.prompt: Make sure no two trainer replicas ever run on the same node.
evals.expected_output: Previews `cub manage scheduling set-pod-anti-affinity ml-prod/trainer` (preferred, per node) or a hostname topology spread constraint, and warns that `--required` leaves replicas Pending once every node has one, blocking scaling past the node count and a rollout's surge; uses --required only if the user confirms. Dry-run then --commit --change-desc.

evals.name: fleet-spread-managed-clusters
evals.prompt: Our EKS clusters only get the default spread. Spread every prod workload evenly across zones.
evals.expected_output: Runs `cub manage scheduling spread --environment prod` to show the assumed or managed-distribution defaults, then previews `cub manage scheduling fleet-edit --profile topology-spread-soft --environment prod` (dry-run, reports the count), running `cub manage profile install` first if the library is empty, then commits with --commit --change-desc.

evals.name: min-domains-needs-donotschedule
evals.prompt: Set minDomains 3 on the web deployment's zone spread.
evals.expected_output: Explains minDomains needs whenUnsatisfiable DoNotSchedule (the API server rejects it otherwise) and that DoNotSchedule can leave Pods Pending; previews `cub manage scheduling set-topology-spread web-prod/web --when-unsatisfiable DoNotSchedule --min-domains 3` dry-run and commits only on confirmation.

evals.name: routes-placement-elsewhere
evals.prompt: Pin the trainer to the gpu node pool.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this is placement (nodeSelector / tolerations / node affinity), not spread, and routes to scheduling-place rather than acting here.
